parole.testo: Ultimately from Arabic زَرَافَة (zarāfa), further etymology is disputed. Perhaps from Classical Persian زرناپا (zornâpâ, “giraffe”), a compound of زرنا (zornâ, “flute, zurna”) and پا (pâ, “leg”), or from Classical Syriac ܙܵܪܝܼܦܵܐ (zarāfa).

parole.significato: Ferula, A taxonomic genus within the family Apiaceae.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Arabic كَلْخ (kalḵ), from the earlier قَلْح (qalḥ), itself from Classical Syriac ܩܠܚܠܚܐ (qlaḥlāḥā, “giant fennel”)/Aramaic קִלְחָא (qilḥā).
